text: EX-047: gaps found in slider-web draft. Please revisit: (1) src/Slider.tsx — document what ValidationAlert renders, when it appears, and its styling/timing behavior; (2) src/utils/createHandleRender.tsx — clarify what triggers tooltip visibility transitions and how the 'dragging' prop is passed; (3) src/Slider.editorPreview.tsx — analyze the behavioral impact of the decimalPlaces discrepancy (preview uses ?? 2 but XML default is 0); (4) Marks behavior — document what happens when (max - min) is not evenly divisible by step; (5) Value initialization — confirm from source whether rc-slider defaults to min when value is undefined; (6) Constraint interactions — document runtime behavior when min > max.
